Package ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.model

package ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.model
Contains the domain model classes for the Occupi application.

This package provides the core data structures that represent buildings, rooms, events, and related information for tracking room occupancy and availability. The model supports serialization to and from JSON format for persistence and data exchange.

Core Entity Classes

  • Building - Represents a building containing rooms and floors
  • BuildingInfo - Record containing building metadata (name, address, etc.)
  • Room - Represents a physical room with capacity, equipment, and events
  • Event - Record representing scheduled events in rooms

Support Classes

  • RoomEquipment - Record describing equipment available in a room
  • RoomInfrastructure - Enum for infrastructure types (projector, whiteboard, etc.)
  • RoomState - Enum representing room availability states
  • RoomType - Enum for different room types (classroom, meeting room, etc.)

Design Notes

The model uses a mix of mutable classes (Building, Room) and immutable records (BuildingInfo, Event, RoomEquipment) to balance flexibility with data integrity. All model classes include Jackson annotations for JSON serialization support.
